verdict.rationale: Conductor's docs show each task gets a terminal, diff view, and chat with the underlying agent (Claude Code/Codex/etc.), and that agents can run builds and tests directly, implying developers can ask natural-language questions to troubleshoot failures within a workspace. However, there's no explicit documentation or example of a debugging/troubleshooting NL workflow (e.g., 'why did this test fail?' queries), only inferred capability from general agent/terminal features. missing for 10: dedicated debugging-via-NL feature documentation, concrete example of troubleshooting query/response, independent confirmation of this specific use case.
